MAIN.read: Complete abstract, Introduction, all Results and Discussion, Methods, captions, availability, disclosures and references list read via extracted JATS blocks M000-M125. Reference titles were inventoried, not their cited papers. M000-M075 are article body/metadata; references start M076. Duplicate nested captions and math TeX/MathML occur in extraction; never count them as new evidence.
MAIN.figure_resolution: Repository-supplied HTML JPGs; no main publisher PDF page inspection or quantitative curve digitization.

SI.page_numbering: PDF page number equals printed page number. Pages 1,10,15 read as extracted text; their whole-page pixels were not inspected. All figure/table-containing pages were inspected.

VIDEO.read_status: Six sampled frames only; frame at 0 s blank. Samples show side/bottom views, distinct slow/fast evaporation segments and variable playback speed. No continuous playback, frame-by-frame timing analysis, original acquisition timestamps, or audio inspection.

SOURCE_DATA.unread: All worksheet numerical contents, formulas, uncertainty calculations and underlying raw-image metadata. No source worksheet for SI Fig9 appears in the sheet-name inventory.

EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCIES.read_status: Cited cTFM implementation, quantum-dot synthesis, NanoDrip printing sources and prior material-modulus sources not opened; no claim of their procedures or code being reproduced.
EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCIES.code: Author cTFM code available on request; not acquired or run.
EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCIES.data: Additional data available on request; no outreach made.

access_policy: Ordinary public repository retrieval recorded by independent source review; no source access performed by this contract implementation.
source_storage: Private audit files and all source media omitted from release; inspection records are factual metadata only.
